name: civic-layout-control
description: Safely inspect, preview, and edit CivicResultMaps layout drafts from Codex.

interface.longDescription: Inspect, validate, preview, and save constrained changes to CivicResultMaps layout drafts. Immutable revisions require explicit review, and production publishing is intentionally unavailable.
defaultPrompt: Inspect the current CivicResultMaps layout drafts and explain what is editable.
Preview a safer, clearer layout change without saving it.
Apply the layout changes I approved to the named draft.
